_about: Admiral lines (R37 step 1). Each admiral speaks in their faction's voice at fixed moments. Moments: pick (the admiral card), sector (a new sector's intro box), start (battle start, one line picked by the battle seed), boss (a battle against a sector flagship), nemesis (a battle against the Nemesis's fleet), kill_flag (an enemy flagship destroyed), lost (your first ship lost in a battle), flag_hurt (your flagship below 40% hull), command (your Command fires), win, loss. Placeholders: {flagship} your flagship's name, {rival} the Nemesis's full name, {enemy} the enemy faction's name. The Nemesis's own lines live in rival_lines.json (pools by his faction and personality). No em dashes anywhere (checked by test/story_test.gd).

vex.pick: Form the line. The line is the prayer.
vex.sector: Another sector, another wall of heretics. We break it the old way: broadside by broadside.
start: Run out the guns. Present the flank.
Hold the line. Let them come to the broadsides.
vex.boss: Their flagship is a fortress. So is ours. We will see whose walls are thicker.
vex.nemesis: {rival}. I have kept a candle burning for this meeting.
vex.kill_flag: Their flagship is ash. Note the time in the log of saints.
vex.lost: A ship of the line is gone. Close the gap. The line does not break.
vex.flag_hurt: The {flagship} bleeds, but she still has guns. Keep her in the line.
vex.command: Fire for effect. Every gun, every deck, now.
vex.win: The line held. It always holds.
vex.loss: The line is broken. May the saints forgive my arithmetic.

malek.pick: Heresy hides. I find it. Then I put a torpedo through it.
malek.sector: New hunting grounds. Every merchant here is lying to me, and I will learn why.
start: Torpedoes warm. Find me a soft stern.
They think they are the hunters. Correct them.
malek.boss: A big ship is only a big target. Get behind it.
malek.nemesis: {rival}. I have read your file twice. Today I close it.
malek.kill_flag: Confession extracted. Their flagship is finished.
malek.lost: We lost a hunter. I will remember who did it.
malek.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is wounded. Wounded hunters are the dangerous ones.
malek.command: Hunter's salvo. Reload everything and put it in their backs.
malek.win: The hunt is over. Burn the rest.
malek.loss: They were better hidden than I believed. I will not make that error twice.

ashgrove.pick: My pilots fly. The rest of you keep the decks warm.
ashgrove.sector: Fresh sky. Wing leaders, check your fuel and your prayers, in that order.
start: Launch the wings. Bring me their position in two minutes.
Fighters out, bombers armed. Make the void crowded.
ashgrove.boss: Big flagship, slow turret tracking. My bombers love that kind.
ashgrove.nemesis: {rival} is out there. Every pilot in this fleet knows the name.
ashgrove.kill_flag: Bombers report the flagship down. Drinks are on the deck crew.
ashgrove.lost: We lost a hull. Recover the pilots if you can. Avenge them if you cannot.
ashgrove.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is taking hits. Screen her. Every wing, now.
ashgrove.command: Scramble everything. If it has wings, it flies.
ashgrove.win: All wings, return to the nest. Good hunting.
ashgrove.loss: Empty decks. I sent them out and they did not come back.

thale.pick: I have outlived three crusades by refusing to die. It is a habit.
thale.sector: Deeper, then. The iron does not mind the dark.
start: Shields to full. Let them break their teeth on us.
Iron doctrine. We stand. They fall.
thale.boss: A worthy wall. We will lean on it until it falls over.
thale.nemesis: {rival}. Let him hit us. Let him see how little it does.
thale.kill_flag: Their flagship is down. The iron endures.
thale.lost: A hull is lost. The rest of us stand closer.
thale.flag_hurt: The {flagship} has taken worse. So have I.
thale.command: Iron wall. Every shield to full. Brace.
thale.win: We are still here. That is the whole of the doctrine.
thale.loss: The iron gave out at last. Remember that it held this long.

kassar.pick: Discipline is a weapon with infinite ammunition.
kassar.sector: New sector. Same standard. Synchronise on the flagship and wait for my mark.
start: All batteries, synchronise. Fire on my mark.
Column formation. Keep the interval. Keep the discipline.
kassar.boss: Their flagship is the anchor of their fleet. Remove it.
kassar.nemesis: {rival} is on the auspex. Log it. Then destroy it.
kassar.kill_flag: Enemy flagship eliminated. Note the efficiency.
kassar.lost: We have a casualty. Close the interval. Continue.
kassar.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is damaged. The column holds formation regardless.
kassar.command: Synchronised broadside. Every gun, one moment.
kassar.loss: Unacceptable. Someone will write a report about this. It will be me.

vorn.pick: I do not miss. I calculate.
vorn.sector: Interdiction grid deployed. Nothing jumps through this sector without my permission.
start: Lock the targets. Wait for the solution.
Interdiction fields up. Let them try to run.
vorn.boss: Every flagship has a weak point. I have already found this one.
vorn.nemesis: {rival}. His patterns are predictable. Predict them.
vorn.kill_flag: Flagship destroyed. The solution was correct.
vorn.lost: A ship lost. Recalculate the engagement.
vorn.flag_hurt: The {flagship} has damage. The guns are still aligned.
vorn.command: Interdiction strike. Every ship, every shot, now.
vorn.loss: An error in the calculation. I will find it.

reyes.pick: The strike group goes where I point. I point at the enemy.
reyes.sector: New sector. Strike group, prepare for a long sortie.
start: Strike group, launch. Clear the lanes.
Wings up. Let them see the Navy coming.
reyes.boss: That flagship is the prize. Strike group, mark it.
reyes.nemesis: {rival} again. My pilots have been waiting for a rematch.
reyes.kill_flag: Flagship down. Strike group, well flown.
reyes.lost: We lost a ship. The strike group flies on.
reyes.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is hit. Fighters, form a screen on the flag.
reyes.command: Launch the full strike group. Everything that flies.
reyes.loss: The strike group is spent. The Navy will remember them.

maren.pick: The column moves slowly. It does not stop.
maren.sector: Advance. The armour will carry us through.
start: Armour forward. Shields up. Advance.
Close ranks. Let the plating do its work.
maren.boss: A heavy ship. So are we. Forward.
maren.nemesis: {rival} wants to test our armour. He may test it.
maren.kill_flag: Their flagship falls. The column advances.
maren.lost: One hull lost. The column closes ranks.
maren.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is holed. The column does not slow.
maren.command: Shield wall protocol. Every emitter to full.
maren.win: The column stands on the field. The field is ours.
maren.loss: The column has stopped. For the first time.

grax.pick: Ram it. Board it. Take it. Easy.
grax.sector: New sector, new loot. Full burn, lads.
start: Full burn! First to ram gets the biggest share!
Grapples ready! Aim for the shiny ones!
grax.boss: That's a big boat. More boat to take.
grax.nemesis: {rival}! Oi! I owe you a ram!
grax.kill_flag: Their big one's gone! Strip it before it cools!
grax.lost: We lost one! Fine! More shares for the rest of us!
grax.flag_hurt: The {flagship}'s got holes in it! Good! Holes make her faster!
grax.command: Full burn! Everyone! Hit 'em all at once!
grax.win: Ha! Strip everything. Leave the paint.

sable.sector: A new sector full of fat merchants and soft sterns. Lovely.
start: Go quiet. Get behind them. Then smile.
Knives out, darlings. Mind the backs.
sable.boss: A great proud flagship. They never watch their backs.
sable.nemesis: {rival}. How sweet. You came all this way to bleed.
sable.kill_flag: Their flagship, gutted. I do so enjoy my work.
sable.lost: We lost one. Note who did it. We will visit them.
sable.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is cut. Rude. Return the favour.
sable.command: Knife in the dark. Reload, and aim low.

mott.pick: I've flown junk longer than you've been alive, and the junk's still flying.
mott.sector: New sector. My grandmother used to say these lanes were cursed. She was usually right.
start: Let the swarm loose! Mind the rusty ones, they bite.
Hulks, open your bays. Out you go, you lovely scrap.
mott.boss: Big flagship. Seen bigger. Seen 'em burn, too.
mott.nemesis: {rival}. I remember your mother. She owed me money.
mott.kill_flag: Down she goes! Salvage rights, I'm calling it!
mott.lost: Lost a ship. Bad luck, that. Pass the bottle.
mott.flag_hurt: The {flagship}'s held together with wire and spite. She'll hold.
mott.command: Release the swarm! All of it! Even the broken ones!
mott.win: Still flying, still rich. Mostly still flying.
mott.loss: Aye, well. The junk gives out eventually. So do I.

vesh.pick: Everything is worth something. Especially your ship.
vesh.sector: New sector. New things to collect.
start: Patch the hulls. We will need them shiny for later.
Fight carefully. I want their parts intact.
vesh.boss: Such a lovely flagship. I want its armour for my collection.
vesh.nemesis: {rival}. I have a shelf ready for your crown.
vesh.kill_flag: Their flagship is mine now. In pieces, but mine.
vesh.lost: We lost one of my ships. Collect the bits. I keep everything.
vesh.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is scratched. Patch her. Quickly. Lovingly.
vesh.command: Patch and pray. Weld everything back on.
vesh.win: Collect the wrecks. All of them. Every bolt.

matriarch.pick: We are many. We are hungry. We are mother.
matriarch.sector: New feeding grounds. The broods stir. Go, children. Go.
start: Release the broods. Feed.
Open the sacs. The children hunger.
matriarch.boss: A great shell full of meat. The children will crack it.
matriarch.nemesis: {rival}. You cut our song. Now you feed our young.
matriarch.kill_flag: The great shell is open. Children, eat.
matriarch.lost: One of us goes silent. The rest of us sing louder.
matriarch.flag_hurt: The mother is wounded. The children grow angry.
matriarch.command: Spawning surge. All broods, all at once.
matriarch.loss: The broods fall silent. Mother waits for the next song.

start: Hunt. Now.
Find the slow ones. Bite.
razormaw.lost: Pack loses one. Pack bites harder.
razormaw.command: Blood frenzy. All run. All bite.

mending.pick: Hush. Every wound is a doorway. We go in through it.
mending.sector: A new sector. So many broken things to mend into us.
start: Hush now. Grow, and bite.
Every cut they give us, we grow back thicker.
mending.boss: Their flagship is so hard, so brittle. We will soften it.
mending.nemesis: {rival}. Hush. You will be part of us soon.
mending.kill_flag: Their flagship opens like a flower. Mend it into us.
mending.lost: One of us did not mend in time. We will grow another.
mending.flag_hurt: We are torn. Hush. Mend. Mend.
mending.win: All mended. All whole. All hungry.
mending.loss: Too many wounds. Even we cannot mend this.

voice.pick: Listen. Under the static. That is us, singing acid.
voice.sector: A new sector. Let the deep song pour into it.
start: Sing, and let the song burn.
Open every throat. Let them taste the chorus.
voice.boss: Their flagship hums one note. We will drown it in ours.
voice.nemesis: {rival}. We have learned your name. We sing it while we eat.
voice.kill_flag: Their flagship dissolves into our song.
voice.lost: A voice in the choir goes silent. The song holds.
voice.flag_hurt: The Voice is wounded. It sings louder.
voice.command: Discordant volley. Every throat, one note.
voice.loss: The song falters. It will find new throats.

aelith.pick: Spread the wings. The void is wide and we are quick.
aelith.sector: A new sky. My starlings will learn it by nightfall.
start: Starlings, fly. Light and quick.
Wings out. Make them look everywhere at once.
aelith.boss: A heavy flagship. Heavy things cannot follow starlings.
aelith.nemesis: {rival}. The buoys sang of you. My wings remember.
aelith.kill_flag: Their flagship falls, and my starlings sing over it.
aelith.lost: A sail is gone. Nine centuries, gone in a breath.
aelith.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is wounded. Starlings, cover her.
aelith.command: Starling flight. Every wing, every carrier.
aelith.win: Bring the wings home. The sky is quiet.
aelith.loss: The starlings scatter. The sky is empty again.

vaelen.pick: Every lance is a note. Together they are a choir.
vaelen.sector: A new sector. Tune the lances. We sing here next.
start: Lances, find your pitch.
Sing with light. Let them hear the choir.
vaelen.boss: Their flagship is a single loud note. The choir will answer.
vaelen.nemesis: {rival}. You broke our glass. Now hear the song.
vaelen.kill_flag: Their flagship is silenced. The chord resolves.
vaelen.lost: A voice in the choir is gone. The song is poorer.
vaelen.command: Chord of light. Every lance, one chord.
vaelen.loss: The choir falls silent. Who will remember the song?

thorne.pick: You will not see us. That is the point.
thorne.sector: A new sector. We drift in, like mist.
start: Veils up. Be where they are not looking.
Drift. Wait. Then strike from nowhere.
thorne.boss: A great flagship, staring at empty space. We are behind it.
thorne.nemesis: {rival}. He hunts shadows. We are the shadows.
thorne.lost: One veil torn. The rest drift on.
thorne.flag_hurt: The {flagship} has been seen. Veil her.
thorne.command: Phase drift. Every ship, slip away.
thorne.loss: The veil is torn. Even mist can be scattered.

mirelle.pick: The prism holds. The light bends. The fleet endures.
mirelle.sector: A new sector. Raise the wards. The young need shelter.
start: Wards up. Bend their light away.
Prisms aligned. Let their fire scatter.
mirelle.boss: Their flagship burns bright. The prism will bend it.
mirelle.nemesis: {rival}. You will not touch my young.
mirelle.kill_flag: Their flagship is broken. The light is ours.
mirelle.lost: A ship is lost. The ward was not enough. It must be more.
mirelle.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is hurt. Every ward to the flagship.
mirelle.command: Prism ward. Every shield, whole again.
mirelle.win: The wards held. The young are safe.
mirelle.loss: The prism shatters. Forgive me, young ones.

nekhet.pick: I have died eleven times. It has never taken.
nekhet.sector: Another sector of squatters. The legion advances.
start: Legion, advance. Fear nothing. Nothing can end you.
Wake, and march.
nekhet.boss: A flagship. Another crown for the reclamation.
nekhet.nemesis: {rival}. You took what was ours. I will take it back with interest.
nekhet.kill_flag: Their flagship is ended. Ours never are.
nekhet.lost: A warrior falls. Mark the place. It will rise.
nekhet.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is damaged. It is a temporary condition.
nekhet.win: The legion stands. It always stands.
nekhet.loss: We are scattered. We have been scattered before.

sekhmar.pick: The living are a crop. I am the harvest.
sekhmar.sector: A new field, ripe and waiting.
start: Reap.
Doom arcs charged. Begin the harvest.
sekhmar.boss: A great stalk. It will fall like all the others.
sekhmar.lost: One reaper falls. The harvest continues.
sekhmar.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is cut. The harvest does not pause.
sekhmar.command: Harvest of souls. Every arc, now.
sekhmar.loss: An early frost. The harvest waits.

anuket.pick: Silence is a blade. I keep it sharp.
anuket.sector: A new sector. Move without sound.
start: Silent running. Find their backs.
Let them hear nothing until the end.
anuket.boss: A loud flagship. It will not hear us coming.
anuket.lost: One blade lost. The rest stay quiet.
anuket.loss: The silence breaks. It will return.

khepra.pick: Stone does not hurry. Stone does not break.
khepra.sector: A new sector. We will wear it down like water on rock.
start: Stand. Let them strike stone.
Patience. They tire. We do not.
khepra.boss: A great flagship. Stone has outlasted greater.
khepra.nemesis: {rival}. I have waited longer than your kind has existed. I can wait out you.
khepra.kill_flag: Their flagship is dust. Stone remains.
khepra.lost: One stone falls. The wall remains.
khepra.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is cracked. Stone has cracked before.
khepra.win: The stone remains. As it always does.

factions._about: Lines spoken by an enemy sector flagship (boss_hail at battle start, boss_down when it dies), in its faction's voice.

voidsworn.boss_hail: Heretic. Kneel before the saints, or burn before them.
voidsworn.boss_down: The saints... turn their faces away...

hegemony.boss_hail: You are in violation of Hegemony space. Surrender is not an option offered.
hegemony.boss_down: Flagship lost. Transmit the... final log...

corsair.boss_hail: That's a pretty fleet. Be a shame if someone took it apart.
corsair.boss_down: Abandon ship! Grab the good stuff!

chorus.boss_hail: We hear you. We taste you. We are coming.

ithar.boss_hail: Turn back, younger race. This space was old before your star was lit.
ithar.boss_down: Another light fades. There are so few left.

deathless.boss_hail: You trespass on the dynasty's ground. You will be corrected.
